inputs.52.text: Stylish 1980s Japanese gothic OVA anime character design with the elegance of a fashion illustration: razor-thin, wiry black ink lines in which every contour breaks into straight segments and sharp corners, elongated figures about nine heads tall with small heads, long necks and long tapering hands, pointed chins and sharp jawlines, long narrow almond eyes under a single sharp upper lash line, hair drawn as long fine separate strands, hard angular cel shadows cut like paper in deep indigo and blue-black, a restrained palette with deep crimson and lamp-gold accents. Character reference of a trim, upright Victorian doctor around fifty with a lean, slim build, straight military bearing and long legs: a firm, angular face with a straight nose, a defined jaw, warm brown eyes under level brows, a neatly trimmed brown moustache, short side-parted brown hair greying at the temples. He wears a close-fitting brown tweed three-piece suit with a gold watch chain across a flat waistcoat, a white wing collar and a dark green tie, and brown leather shoes. He stands upright in a three-quarter view turned toward screen right, arms relaxed at his sides, a kind, attentive face. Plain flat pale blue-grey background, even soft frontal light, the figure filling the frame from head to feet.
